description: Short RUES matrícula status for a Colombian NIT: estado (ACTIVA, CANCELADA...), last renewal, vigencia and whether it is active. Legal entities / ESAL only; natural-person data is never returned. Source: Confecámaras RUES via datos.gov.co (CC BY-SA 4.0); not an official RUES/DIAN service. Free: 20 calls per client per UTC day, shared by the Colombia tools (co_company_status, co_company_lookup). When the free quota is used up the tool returns an error naming the paid HTTP endpoint https://co.redtapeapi.com/v1/company/{nit}/status ($0.003 USDC per successful call over x402 on Base, no account or API key).

nit.description: Colombian NIT, digits with optional check digit, e.g. 900170781 or 900170781-7

name: co_company_status
title: Colombia RUES company status by NIT
